content:
leo: Noticing a blip: validator v2.1 rollout is rejecting a batch of fncalls to `doc-annotate` and those requests are not hitting `doc-annotate-lite` fallback.

sana: saw that too. example logs: 

sana: ```
2025-04-02T11:07:12Z ERROR invoke.reject service=validator v=2.1 request=rb-fff111 tool=doc-annotate reason="field 'annotations': expected array, got string" route=primary
2025-04-02T11:07:12Z WARN routing.fallback request=rb-fff111 candidate=doc-annotate-lite decision=REJECTED reason="handshake_gate=exact mismatch"
```

ops-runner: handshake_gate=exact? I thought the catalog migration set `variant_matching=partial` for all lite variants. Did that PR not land?

leo: dev-console shows doc-annotate-lite has catalog flag `variant_matching=off` from the 2025-03-27 bulk update. that explains NO_MATCH on fallback.

telemetry: correlating metrics: validator.rejects spike + routing.fallback.rejected increased by 1200 in last 10m. most affected customers are eu-west test slices.

product-ux: customers will see intermittent 400 fncall responses instead of best-effort downgrade. this will surface as "inconsistent behavior" in the console. we should mark the route status and surface a small banner while we fix.

sana: quick mitigation options: 1) flip `variant_matching` for doc-annotate-lite to `partial` (fast), 2) change validator v2.1 to emit a permissive-coercion hint to router (medium), or 3) roll back validator v2.1 canary slice (slow but safe).

leo: i prefer 1 + 2. flip catalog now, then schedule coercion in validator v2.2. but agree we need better telemetry to show why fallback failed (handshake vs signature mismatch vs auth).

ops-runner: i'll publish catalog change and tag it with a revert label. also will add a transient metric `fallback.failed_reason` to the routing pipeline so alerts can break down by reason.

dev-deploy-bot: catalog publish success: catalog-id=mc-9001 version=2025-04-02T11:20.

telemetry: after publish, routing.fallback.rejected for doc-annotate down 95% in 3m. fallback.decisions now show candidate=doc-annotate-lite decision=ACCEPTED for previously rejected samples.

product-ux: next console patch requests: add `validation_policy` and `fallback_reason` to the per-request trace and make the route list show a status pill when recent rejects >1% for 5m. filing PX-5310.

leo: follow-ups: - alert tuning: split schema.rejects alert into {canary,stable} buckets; fire page only for stable unless >200% uplift. - telemetry: sample payloads (PII redaction) for rejected fncalls with reason tag. - validator: plan coercion work and feature flag gate.

sana: i'll take the alert PR and add suppression for canary slices.

ops-runner: live update: support says two customers pinged but no major outage. i'll keep the revert tag on the catalog entry for quick rollback.

leo: thanks. i'll update the rollout notes and add a short doc to runbook about handshake_gate vs variant_matching differences.

product-ux: adding a short explanation paragraph to the console help text so operators understand why identical prompts sometimes route differently.

telemetry: logging note: please ensure we don't capture any full-document text in samples; only length, field types, and scrubbed example values.

leo: great. closing here, will follow up with tickets and a short postmortem if validator coercion isn't ready before next canary.
